page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge is a virtualized workstation instance type within the GPU-accelerated compute-optimized family. It is built on an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 2 physical cores with hyperthreading enabled, accompanied by 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache. System memory totals 16.0 GB, allocating roughly 3.88 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered via a fractional slice of an NVIDIA A10 GPU, allocating approximately 0.0833 of the physical processor and 2 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance features no local storage and includes a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place the instance primarily in average performance bands for its hardware class. The system recorded a Geekbench 6 single-core score of 1554.0 and a multi-core score of 5066.0, aligned with stress-ng single-core and multi-core ratings of 1904.08 and 7176.28. While caching allows small-block read operations to reach 420.9 GB/sec, uncached 256 MB memory bandwidth settles at 48.98 GB/sec for reads and 30.83 GB/sec for writes. PassMark metrics indicate weaker memory and database operation scores in the bottom quartile, alongside multi-threaded bzip3 decompression dropping into the bottom 10 percent at 21.1 GB/sec. Conversely, the fractional NVIDIA A10 GPU supports light inference tasks, delivering 411.88 tokens per second on prompt processing and 111.74 tokens per second on text generation using a compact 135M parameter language model.

The instance offers fractional GPU provisioning, enabling entry-level graphics and lightweight machine learning acceleration without paying for a full enterprise accelerator. The primary tradeoff lies in constrained compute density, memory bandwidth limitations under heavy parallel loads, and the strict 2 GB VRAM limit, which rules out medium or large language models. The ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge instance fits light virtual workstation streaming, entry-level CAD rendering, GUI application hosting, and micro-model AI inference pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn7i-vws-m2.xlarge is a virtual workstation instance powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 4 vCPUs, 2 physical cores, and 16.0 GB of RAM. It features a fractional NVIDIA A10 accelerator offering 2 GB of VRAM alongside 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, with no bundled local storage. In standardized testing, the instance exhibits mid-tier CPU throughput with a Geekbench multi-core score of 5066.0 and stress-ng multi-core score of 7176.28, although memory-intensive database tasks and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression register lower. The 2 GB GPU slice accommodates small-scale model inference, achieving 111.74 tokens per second on text generation for a 135M parameter model. The instance is suited for lightweight virtual workstations, remote desktop streaming, basic graphic rendering, and compact AI inference workloads requiring minimal GPU overhead.
